name: Tecsys
description: Uruguayan online store for notebooks, gaming PCs, components, monitors, printers and supplies, with some small appliances. Ships across Uruguay and delivers same day in Montevideo and Ciudad de la Costa.
description_es: Tienda online uruguaya de notebooks, equipos gamer, componentes, monitores, impresoras e insumos, con algunos pequeños electrodomésticos. Envía a todo el país y entrega en el día en Montevideo y Ciudad de la Costa.

ships_to.notes: FAQ says shipping to the whole country; free same-day delivery in Montevideo and Ciudad de la Costa for orders before 17

fulfillment.pickup_notes: FAQ lists Retiro en Local (Pickup Center) but does not say whether it applies to online orders.

endpoints.notes: Plain-text llms.txt published by the store for AI assistants.

shopping_notes: Robots.txt disallows Amazonbot and Applebot-Extended and carries content signals; automated access should follow robots.txt.

sources.supports: FAQ section Sobre los envios: delivery options and Pickup Center
